name: Voxel Splatting SART/SIRT
definition: An implementation of SART/SIRT proximal operators based on voxel splatting, where voxels are splatted into the detector to update ray-sum and weights images, using pre-integrated lookup tables for weights.
summary: Voxel Splatting SART/SIRT is a GPU-accelerated tomographic reconstruction method that projects voxels onto the detector plane, distinguishing itself from ray casting by inverting the data flow to accumulate contributions into ray-sum and weight images.
